meta.name: data-quality-frameworks
meta.description: Implement data quality validation with Great Expectations, dbt tests, and data contracts. Use when building data quality pipelines, implementing validation rules, or establishing data contracts.

copy.tagline: 自动验证数据质量,提前发现数据问题
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果你负责数据管道,需要自动检查数据质量,避免坏数据流入下游。
copy.tagline_en: Catch data issues early with automated quality checks.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you run data pipelines and want automated quality checks to catch issues early.

howto.what: 装上后 Claude 会用 Great Expectations、dbt tests 和数据契约来搭数据质量校验：写期望断言、跑检查、生成每张表的通过/失败报告，不合格时让流水线报错中断。
howto.when: 当你在建数据质量流水线、写校验规则，或要在团队间建立数据契约时接管；也用于 CI/CD 中的自动数据校验。

say.text: 帮我的 orders 表写一套 Great Expectations 校验
say.note: 生成非空、唯一等期望断言

say.text: 给这几张表跑数据质量检查并出一份报告
say.note: 输出每表通过/失败与失败明细

say.text: 数据质量不合格就让流水线报错退出
say.note: 检查失败会抛错中断流程

howto.what_en: Once installed, Claude builds data quality validation with Great Expectations, dbt tests, and data contracts: writes expectation assertions, runs checks, and produces per-table pass/fail reports that can fail the pipeline.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you build data quality pipelines, implement validation rules, or establish data contracts between teams; also used for automated validation in CI/CD.

say_en.text: Write a Great Expectations suite for my orders table
Run data quality checks on these tables and give me a report
say_en.note: Shows pass/fail and failed checks per table

say_en.text: Fail the pipeline when data quality checks don't pass
say_en.note: Raises an error to stop the pipeline
